content: Help me estimate cost for a 10 marla grey structure project in Karachi DHA.

**10 Marla Grey Structure Cost Estimate — DHA Karachi (April 2026)**

*Total built-up area (G+1): approx. 2,250 sqft*

| Item | Quantity | Rate | Cost |
|------|---------|------|------|
| Foundation | Lump sum | — | PKR 6–8 lacs |
| Brick masonry | 22,000 bricks | PKR 18 | PKR 3.96 lacs |
| Cement (bags) | 900 bags | PKR 1,330 | PKR 11.97 lacs |
| Steel rebar | 10 tonnes | PKR 282/kg | PKR 28.2 lacs |
| Shuttering & formwork | Lump sum | — | PKR 4–5 lacs |
| Sand & crush | 80 trolleys | PKR 4,800 avg | PKR 3.84 lacs |
| Labour (mason+helper) | 600 man-days | PKR 2,500 avg | PKR 15 lacs |
| Miscellaneous (5%) | — | — | PKR 4 lacs |
| **Total** | | | **PKR 77–80 lacs** |

*Note: DHA Karachi premium adds ~8–10% vs SITE area.*

Want a breakdown for full finish instead?
Yes please also include full finish estimate so I can give client options

**Full Finish Add-on Costs — 10 Marla, DHA Karachi**

| Finishing Item | Estimated Cost |
|---------------|---------------|
| Floor tiles (imported, 800sqft) | PKR 8–12 lacs |
| Wall tiles (kitchen + bathrooms) | PKR 3–4 lacs |
| Internal plaster + paint | PKR 5–7 lacs |
| Woodwork (doors, frames, kitchen) | PKR 9–13 lacs |
| Electrical wiring + fixtures | PKR 6–8 lacs |
| Plumbing + sanitary fittings | PKR 5–7 lacs |
| External plaster + paint | PKR 3–4 lacs |
| **Total Finishing** | **PKR 39–55 lacs** |

---

| Package | Total Cost |
|---------|------------|
| Grey Structure Only | PKR 77–80 lacs |
| Full Finish (standard) | PKR 116–135 lacs |
| Full Finish (premium) | PKR 145–160 lacs |

*These are competitive rates for DHA Karachi. You can confidently quote PKR 3,200–3,800 per sqft for full finish in this area.*
